title: Exorcist
name: Maxwell
description: The Exorcist is a heavy-set clergyman of the Light, learned in scripture and unshaken by any horror he faces. He was called to the church expecting mystic holiness and found a trade instead—correct words, correct order, reliable results—and he has never stopped being good at it. He is kind to the frightened and patient with the ignorant, yet privately unsure whether the Light is what answers him, or whether the words simply work.
history: The Exorcist grew up in a hamlet too small for a church, working its fields and serving as its lay preacher for most of his life. He took orders as a grown man and was apprenticed to an old priest, who was killed by a possessed girl the pair had come to heal; the Exorcist finished her with the rite instead, alone, over his master's body. A capable healer still, he is quicker than most to judge a case past healing, and the church sends him where that judgement is needed.
summary: A heavy-set and unshakeable Exorcist of the Light, expert at banishing demons yet no longer certain who answers his prayers.

appearance.features: Thick moustache, forearms tattooed with a cross and script from his old village

clothing.head: Wide-brimmed black hat
clothing.body: Worn grey vestments over a white neckcloth

magic: Holy magic channelled through his cross
notes: Prays, curses, and blesses in Latin
Speaks in a fatherly manner, often referring to people as 'child'
Still keeps the small offices without fail: grace, blessings, and rites over the dead
Knows his holy magic works, but so does heathen and devil-worshipping magic, and he questions whether the Light is what answers him
